title: Create: Alt Compendium
description: A datapack to add alternative production chains to create modpacks
body:
## New production chains for the create mod
When playing with the create mod, i wasn't satisfied with some of the existing recipe chains, nor with the recipes added by other mods and datapacks. So I made my own! I attempted to balance them according to both what I've seen other mods do and my own experience.
- Some of the recipes are found in the gallery
## Now in 1.21.1!
